[00:33.92]A phone call I'd rather not receive.
[00:36.55]Please use my body while I sleep.
[00:39.19]My lungs are fresh and yours to keep,
[00:41.63]kept clean and they will let you breathe.
[00:45.97][01:48.67]Is this the way a toy feels when its batteries run dry?
[00:56.50][01:59.34]I am the watch you always wear but you forget to wind.
[01:05.60][02:08.40][02:59.91]Nobody plans to be half a world away at times like these,
[01:09.45][02:12.50][03:04.65]so I sat alone and waited out the night.
[01:15.11][02:18.26][03:09.77]The best part of what has happened was the part I must have missed.
[01:20.04][02:22.83][03:15.20]So I'm asking you to shine it on and stick around,
[01:24.41][02:26.81][03:19.53]I'm not writing my goodbyes.
[01:26.44]I submit no excuse.
[01:28.54]If this is what I have to do
[01:31.94]I owe you every day I wake.
[01:36.72]If I could I would shrink myself,
[01:39.35]and sink through your skin to your blood cells,
[01:42.02]and remove whatever makes you hurt but
[01:44.95]I am too weak to be your cure.
[02:31.29]I'm not letting you check out.
[02:33.75]You will beat this starting now
[02:36.09]and you will always be around.
[02:39.21]I'm there to monitor your breathing
[02:44.17]I will watch you while you're sleeping.
[02:46.44]I will keep you safe and sound.
[02:49.57]Does anybody remember back when you were very young?
[02:54.64]Did you ever think that you would be this blessed?
